svg.title: Kerebrom AI agent installation flow
svg.desc: A diagram showing how an AI installer reads repository instructions, installs Kerebrom v2, configures detected clients, verifies the binary, and hands the product back to the user.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: From GitHub repo to installed memory layer

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: The agent reads native repo instructions, runs the stable v2 installer, and verifies the user's AI clients.
